spell.tutorialmod.arcane_fire.descriptio: Right-click to launch a burning arcane bolt.
spell.tutorialmod.wind_burst.description: Right-click to throw a concussive wind charge.
spell.tutorialmod.storm_lance.descriptio: Right-click to call lightning at range.
spell.tutorialmod.frost_bind.description: Right-click to slow and wound your target.
spell.tutorialmod.earthen_guard.descript: Right-click to gain absorption and slow falling.
spell.tutorialmod.wither_touch.descripti: Necromancy. Right-click to launch a withering skull.
spell.tutorialmod.soul_drain.description: Necromancy. Right-click to damage a target and heal yourself.
spell.tutorialmod.bone_minion.descriptio: Necromancy. Right-click to raise a skeletal ally.
spell.tutorialmod.grave_mist.description: Necromancy. Right-click to curse nearby enemies.
message.tutorialmod.spell_blocked: The spell cannot resolve into a safe space.
screen.tutorialmod.staff_spell_selection: Select a spell. Hover for details.
class.tutorialmod.warrior.description: Thor is the divine path of thunder and direct force. His weapon is Mjolnir, a soulbound hammer made for melee pressure, lightning impacts, and brutal control.
class.tutorialmod.mage.description: Eir is the divine path of protection and recovery. Her weapon is a soulbound scepter that restores health and raises protective wards.
class.tutorialmod.ranger.description: Artemis is the divine path of the hunt. Her weapon is a soulbound bow that fires divine arrows without consuming ammunition.
screen.tutorialmod.choose_class: Choose your divine path. This choice is permanent for this character.
message.tutorialmod.admin_reset: Divine path reset. Press O when ready to choose again.
message.tutorialmod.power_strike_armed: Mighty Strike charged. Your next melee hit will consume it.
message.tutorialmod.level_up: Divine path level up! You are now level %s.
Active. Call Thor's force into your weapon. Your next melee hit detonates with thunderous single-target damage; the cooldown begins only when the hit lands.
talent.tutorialmod.warrior_steel_skin.de: Passive buff. Storm-tempered skin reduces incoming damage, letting you hold the front line without slowing your assault.
talent.tutorialmod.warrior_charge.descri: Active. Leap forward and crash down with divine force, damaging nearby enemies and throwing them back from the impact point. 12s cooldown.
talent.tutorialmod.warrior_fury.descript: Passive buff. The storm answers every swing, increasing your melee damage and turning sustained close combat into your domain.
Ultimate. For 30 seconds, the sky breaks into Thor's storm. Every melee hit carries Mighty Strike, while divine lightning punishes a random nearby enemy every 3 seconds. 3 min cooldown.
talent.tutorialmod.mage_arcane_bolt.desc: Active. Channel Eir's light into a focused bolt that can be developed into a heal or protective strike for defensive play.
talent.tutorialmod.mage_mana_reserve.des: Passive buff. While protected by a ward, incoming damage is softened further, rewarding careful timing and defensive positioning.
talent.tutorialmod.mage_ethereal_step.de: Active. Slip a short distance through divine grace, repositioning to rescue allies or escape pressure.
talent.tutorialmod.mage_runic_shield.des: Passive buff. Maintains a gentle ward around you, granting light absorption and reducing incoming damage.
talent.tutorialmod.mage_arcane_storm.des: Ultimate. Establish a powerful sacred field concept: protection, healing, and enemy suppression centered on survival rather than burst damage.
talent.tutorialmod.ranger_precise_shot.d: Passive buff. Artemis guides your hand, increasing bow and crossbow damage for clean ranged execution.
talent.tutorialmod.ranger_silent_step.de: Passive buff. Move with predatory calm, gaining speed and keeping distance as your primary defense.
talent.tutorialmod.ranger_trap.descripti: Active. Set a divine snare ahead of you, slowing enemies and opening them to ranged punishment.
talent.tutorialmod.ranger_barrage.descri: Active. Release a fast spread of arrows, ideal for punishing clustered targets or finishing wounded enemies at range.
talent.tutorialmod.ranger_hunters_mark.d: Ultimate. Mark prey before the hunt: exposed enemies become easier to track and more vulnerable to focused ranged damage.
